description: BRT-06 evidence & attestation vectors. Canonical hashes: SHA-256("BR" || 0x01 || domainTag || 0x00 || schemaId "@" version || 0x00 || "br-json/1" || 0x00 || JCS(normalized)). Evidence BYTES are plain SHA-256 (sha256sum). Signing input (RFC 7515 + RFC 7797, b64:false): protected || "." || "bragging-rights/sig/v1:" || hex(statementHash). EdDSA = Ed25519; ES256 = ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 with a fixed 64-byte R||S signature. Key identity: RFC 7638 thumbprint.

eddsa.derivation: Ed25519 seed = SHA-256(UTF-8 "BRT-06 PUBLIC TEST VECTOR KEY - NOT SECRET - NEVER REGISTER")
eddsa.warning: PUBLIC by design. Never register this key; the platform refuses it by RFC 7638 thumbprint.

es256.derivation: P-256 d = (SHA-256(UTF-8 "BRT-06 PUBLIC ES256 TEST VECTOR KEY - NOT SECRET - NEVER REGISTER") mod (n - 1)) + 1
es256.warning: PUBLIC by design. Never register this key; the platform refuses it by RFC 7638 thumbprint.
